review_description: We were one of the early adopters of solar, and NuEnergy installed our 1.5kW system over 11 years ago that hadn't skipped a beat since the day it was installed. Then suddenly during COVID lockdown, we got a text from Solar Trip telling us that our PV system is not exporting power to the grid.With the system our of warranty, we were at loss as to what to do since it was out of warranty. We called NuEnergy as a long shot, but they treated us as if we just had our system installed. The excellent customer service we received is beyond anything we could have hoped to expect after 11 years!To cut the story short, they really did all of the leg work and running around without us having to do anything our end. They explained everything to us clearly, gave us realistic options and organized for everything that needed to be done to get our system back up and running again.Amazing company to deal with, one we highly recommend to anyone looking for genuine customer service and honest, reliable advice. They really know what they're doing and you won't find better out there.

We installed 15 x 330W panels with Enphase micro-inverters in our inner east Melbourne home last year. The system is making a significant dent to our energy bills. I would recommend Nu Energy to anyone. Excellent customer service from Ben working in with our builder and pool company which made it all the more easier.

We don’t have the easiest roof for solar but on the day the installers adapted the original design to ensure we got 17 panels installed.
